text.theCurrentDiagnosticSessionIsStillMemory: The current diagnostic session is still memory-only. Review the report before copying or saving it; imported content, credentials, and user paths are excluded.

text.importedContentFilesystemNamesCredential: Imported content, filesystem names, credentials, and URL secrets are excluded. Attributes come only from the registered event catalog.

text.increasePackageLimitsAtYourOwnRisk: Increase package limits at your own risk
text.largerPackagesCanConsumeSubstantialMemor: Larger packages can consume substantial memory, disk space, and processing time. These limits affect Editor import and export, desktop project loading, and Chain Tracker package installation.
text.pathFileTypeCompressionRatioImageSchemaA: Path, file-type, compression-ratio, image, schema, and atomicity protections remain mandatory and cannot be disabled.
text.homeIsAlwaysTheRootDestinationStartupRed: Home is always the root destination. Startup redirection is an agreed application behavior, not a configurable preference.
text.thesePreferencesArePersistedNowEditorBeh: These preferences are persisted now; Editor behavior remains inert until the Editor workspace is implemented.
text.similarInventoryAggregationIsOnByDefault: Similar inventory aggregation is on by default; the other seven settings are off. Exact versions never duplicate, and upstream review remains material-only and undoable.
text.overridesAreUserLocalDuplicateOrPlatform: Overrides are user-local. Duplicate or platform-reserved bindings are reported before a change is accepted. Editor commands update immediately, including while a workspace remains mounted behind Settings.
text.reducedMotionRemovesNonessentialMovement: Reduced motion removes nonessential movement without hiding state changes or progress feedback.
text.byteBudgetsSharedByEditorImportExportDes: Byte budgets shared by Editor import/export, desktop projects, and Chain Tracker installation.
text.increasedByteBudgetsMayUseSubstantiallyM: Increased byte budgets may use substantially more memory, disk space, and processing time. Other malicious-file protections stay active.
text.includeDetailedDebugEventsUntilTheApplic: Include detailed debug events until the application exits.
text.logsAreNeverPersistedBetweenLaunchesThis: Logs are never persisted between launches. This session control is not stored as a preference.
text.inputDrivenCandidatesWait500MsRepeatedMa: Input-driven candidates wait 500 ms. Repeated matching events update one toast and its occurrence count.
